Name: Wider Meadowlands Bridge
Author: PashaWithHat
Description:
Now with configurable style! Choose from dirt (default), stone, wood, grass, or flowers for your new, wider bridge. Also includes a pass-through pipe graphic for waterflow under the landmass bridges, specifically added for that one commenter.

Makes that tiny, one-tile-wide bridge over to Grandpa's Shrine into a three-tile-wide land crossing. Now it's much easier to use!

Inspired by u/C4ndy_Fl0ss on Reddit.

Downloads.Description: Adds four new bridge types and a config setting
